channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Netanyahu ahead of Likud primaries: I am not interfering in the national slate
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed tomorrow’s Likud primaries, saying he trusts party members to choose their representatives based on their own judgment.
“Tomorrow, I will vote for a winning slate that will ensure that Eisenkot and Yair Golan do not form a narrow government with the Arab parties. I am not interfering in the national slate," Netanyahu said.

item.title: Report: Israel preparing for several days of fighting against Hezbollah
item.description:
The IDF is preparing for the possibility of several days of fighting in Lebanon amid tensions with Hezbollah and military activity in the Ali Taher Ridge and Beaufort Castle areas, according to Channel 12.
According to the report, Israel is determined to destroy terrorist infrastructure in the area, while Hezbollah is attempting to target IDF forces.

item.title: Israeli officer describes finding missing mother and daughter in Argentina
item.description: Israeli officer describes finding missing mother and daughter in Argentina

item.title: US pressure mounts: Kushner arrives in Israel demanding Netanyahu implement Gaza plan
item.description: After meeting Hamas leaders in Egypt, Jared Kushner arrives in Israel to meet Netanyahu. Washington believes PM has agreed in principle to the framework and is demanding its implementation.

item.title: On anniversary of death: US Ambassador Huckabee visits Rabbi Kook's home
item.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee visits Rabbi Abraham Isaac HaCohen Kook’s Jerusalem home and opens an exhibit highlighting Chief Rabbis’ historic White House visits.

item.title: 'Just me, my thoughts, and G-d': Omer Shem Tov recounts Hamas captivity
item.description: Omer Shem Tov releases a new book recounting his 505 days in Hamas captivity, including 50 days alone, and the faith that helped him endure.

item.title: 'It could end in terror': Arabs deface Israeli flags in Binyamin region
item.description: Israeli flags at the Rawabi junction were vandalized with paint after months without incident. Binyamin Council head Yisrael Ganz demands a firm IDF response and warns of escalation.

item.title: Jared Kushner meets with senior Hamas officials in Egypt
item.description:
US President Donald Trump’s advisor, Jared Kushner, met with senior Hamas officials in Egypt today and pressed them to begin fulfilling their commitment to disarm.
Read more.

item.title: Construction workers uncover €9 million treasure hidden in 19th-century Flanden brewery
item.description: Workers renovating a historic Belgian brewery uncovered 49 gold bars and 4,000 ancient coins worth an estimated €9 million-and may now be entitled to a share of the fortune.

item.title: Katzrin unites to commemorate Yehonatan Klimian z"l
item.description: Hundreds of residents, family members, and rabbis gathered for a memorial evening in memory of Yehonatan Klimian z"l, who was killed while rappelling in the Keshet Cave in northern Israel.

item.title: Behind the scenes: Police reveal details from the search for Mali and Liel Yahalomi
item.description: The head of an Interpol unit in the Israel Police describes the search for Mali and Liel Yahalomi: “Initially, we suspected a kidnapping, but it later emerged that it was a planned disappearance."

item.title: From Gandhi’s pistol to today’s hesitation | Nitsana Darshan-Leitner
item.description: Kozo Okamoto's death brought me back to the moment when General Rehavam Ze’evi placed a pistol on the table - and succeeded in breaking his prisoner’s silence. Op-ed

item.title: Col. (res.) Hezi Nehama, one of the authors of the “Generals’ Plan" to defeat Hamas, joins Erdan
item.description:
Col. (res.) Hezi Nehama, a founder of the Reservist Commanders and Fighters Forum and one of the authors of the “Generals’ Plan" to defeat Hamas, announced that he is joining the Unity Party, led by Gilad Erdan.
Nechama stated: “The Unity Party represents the values I have fought for in recent years through the Reservist Commanders and Fighters Forum, and which I intend to advance from the Knesset in approximately three months."

item.title: IDF confirms: Two terrorists who advanced terrorist attacks eliminated in Gaza Strip
item.description:
Earlier today (Sunday), the IDF struck an Islamic Jihad terrorist in the Khan Yunis area and a Hamas terrorist in the Nuseirat area in the Gaza Strip.
The terrorists advanced terror attacks and were struck in precise aerial strikes to remove the threat.
Prior to the strikes, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance.

item.title: Israel, Honduras forge deeper defense partnership amid regional threats
item.description: Defense Ministers Israel Katz and Enrique Rodríguez Burchard signed an agreement expanding security cooperation and strategic ties between Israel and Honduras.

item.title: Report: Trump's secret channel to Iran's IRGC
item.description: The Trump administration reportedly turned to Kurdistan President Nechirvan Barzani for a secret channel to Iran's IRGC during efforts to end the war.

item.title: 67% of Jewish population oppose deal putting Zim in Qatari hands
item.description: A Mano Geva poll shows broad opposition to approving the ZIM deal amid the involvement of Qatari shareholders: 67.1% oppose the deal, just 2.4% support approve the deal despite involvement.

item.title: Second time within an hour: IDF strikes terrorist in Gaza
item.description: Second time within an hour: IDF strikes terrorist in Gaza

item.title: Senior Palestinian Arab source to Al Jazeera: Jared Kushner to meet with Hamas leaders
item.description: A senior Palestinian Arab source told Al Jazeera that US President Donald Trump’s envoy Jared Kushner is expected to meet with Hamas leaders in Cairo shortly, in the presence of senior Qatari, Egyptian, and Turkish officials. He is then expected to travel to Israel.

item.title: i24NEWS crew attacked in Northern Ireland while filming report on antisemitism
item.description: i24NEWS Channel correspondent Yonatan Raveh and videographer Nadav Abas were assaulted in Belfast. The cameraman sustained a head injury from a thrown glass.

item.title: Why did Mali and Liel disappear? Police scratching their heads
item.description: Police say they still do not know why Mali and Liel Yahalomi disappeared, despite a complex international investigation that found no unusual event.

item.title: Hamas documents reveal long-term plan to open a northern front against Israel
item.description: Captured Hamas documents reveal more than a decade of efforts to establish a military infrastructure in Lebanon in coordination with Hezbollah and Iran, including plans for rockets, a 2,000-man fighting force and more.

item.title: PM Netanyahu congratulates Israeli men's marathon team European Athletics Championships gold
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu congratulated the Israeli men's marathon team on their historic win of the team gold medal at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.
"Our athletes displayed extraordinary determination, dedication, and teamwork, bringing immense honor and a great source of national pride to the State of Israel. Well done!" the Prime Minister proclaimed.

item.title: The donkey was always the point
item.description: Democratic socialism is an oxymoronic trojan horse. Socialism is not and cannot be democratic. Opinion.

item.title: New Haredi party could shake up Shas and UTJ
item.description: A haredi politician met with senior rabbis opposed to IDF conscription, as part of talks to establish a new party aimed at restoring the deferment for yeshiva students.

item.title: Everything is computerized, so why do elections rely on paper ballots?
item.description: Shutting down the economy on Election Day costs the Israeli economy between two and three billion shekels. So why not save billions and vote from home? Prof. Orr Dunkelman explains why the traditional ballot box is still preferable.

item.title: MK reveals his demands for the next Israeli government
item.description: MK Simcha Rothman tells Arutz Sheva he wants to continue judicial reform, overhaul the attorney general's powers and help shape the next right-wing government.

item.title: Recovery after the Iran War: GDP jumps 15.4%
item.description: The Central Bureau of Statistics publishes a preliminary estimate according to which GDP jumped in the second quarter of 2026 by 15.4% on an annualized basis, which is 3.6% compared to the previous quarter. The figure reflects a sharp recovery from the war against Iran, but may still be updated.

item.title: Children ate chocolate on vacation and began hallucinating
item.description: Two children, ages five and six, were exposed during a family vacation to chocolate containing hallucinogenic mushrooms and hospitalized.
